Skypark Elara Lakelands

Condominium in Choeng Thale (Laguna Lakelands)
HomeNew ProjectsSkypark Elara Lakelands

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the completed project.

Project overview

Skypark Elara Lakelands is a low-rise seven-storey condominium within Laguna Lakelands, a residential community beside the Laguna Phuket resort. The first phase comprises three blocks with around 220 one-, two- and three-bedroom units. Facilities include a rooftop infinity-edge pool and a terrace with barbecue area. Owners can access Laguna Lakelands and Laguna Phuket community facilities.

Facilities & amenities

  • Rooftop infinity-edge pool
  • Outdoor terrace with BBQ and sitting areas
  • Private balcony per unit
  • Foldable work closets
  • Walking paths overlooking forest and lagoons
  • Community: Laguna Lakelands trail network (15 km), adventure park, sports complex, beachfront club
  • Community: Laguna Phuket resort facilities access

Frequently asked questions

Where is Skypark Elara Lakelands?

Skypark Elara Lakelands is a low-rise condominium project in Choeng Thale (Laguna Lakelands), Phuket, developed by Banyan Group Residences (Banyan Group).

What is the starting price of Skypark Elara Lakelands?

Agent advertised price is ฿9,120,000, last checked 2026-11-14. Prices and availability change, so ask us on WhatsApp for the current figures.

What ownership is offered at Skypark Elara Lakelands?

Sources list freehold ownership. Always confirm the exact title and conditions with a Thai lawyer before buying; this is general information, not legal advice.

When will Skypark Elara Lakelands be ready?

Current status: under construction. Dates can change, so please confirm with us.
